title: Nikon Stripped a $3,000 Win Over AI, and It Changes the Rules for Everyone
excerpt: Nikon disqualified the winning video in its Small World in Motion competition after judges found it broke the no-AI rule. The message for every photographer entering contests: read the fine print, keep your raw files, and know where your editing tools stop being allowed.

title: Is There Such a Thing as Bad Light in Street Photography?
excerpt: Peter Forsgard says good light is a sedative for your visual instincts and that flat gray days expose whether a street photo has a story at all. If you only shoot in golden light, the gray months ahead are your test.

title: How to Tell a Beauty Dish From a Softbox Just by Looking at the Photo
excerpt: Karl Taylor demonstrates how to read a portrait like a forensic scene: shadows reveal the light's position, skin specularity reveals the modifier, and falloff reveals the distance. Once you can read it, any image you admire becomes a diagram you can rebuild.
